title: Musha's ex-Honda team and capacitors in transmission oil

tellings.quote:
There's a team in
Japan, um, I believe they came out of
Honda, and I think Musha is the
scientist's name

plain: A team of researchers in Japan, possibly people who came out of the carmaker Honda, is said to have worked on capacitors, devices that store electric charge, placed in transmission oil as part of work on propulsion without wings or rockets. Michels mentions it himself in an episode about antigravity propulsion, saying he believes the lead scientist is named Musha and making clear he is unsure of the details.
